caseNameFull: Maneja v. Waialua Agricultural Co., Ltd. and Waialua Agricultural Co., Ltd. v. Maneja
attorneys: Solicitor General Sobeloff, Stuart Rothman and Bessie Margolin for movant.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 348 U. S. 870, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The motion for leave to file supplemental brief on behalf of the Secretary of Labor, as amicus curiae, in response to brief filed by the American Farm Bureau Federation is granted'.
